mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( platform_type, platform_order_id, store_id, external_store_id, status, last_source_sequence, event_version, ordered_at, provider_occurred_at, delivery_address, customer_request_text, provider_gross_order_amount_snapshot, provider_customer_paid_amount_snapshot, provider_merchant_funded_discount_snapshot, provider_funded_discount_snapshot, provider_financial_data_status_snapshot ) VALUES ( #{platformType}, #{platformOrderId}, #{storeId}, #{externalStoreId}, #{status}, #{lastSourceSequence}, #{eventVersion}, #{orderedAt}, #{providerOccurredAt}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{customerRequestText}, #{providerGrossOrderAmountSnapshot}, #{providerCustomerPaidAmountSnapshot}, #{providerMerchantFundedDiscountSnapshot}, #{providerFundedDiscountSnapshot}, #{providerFinancialDataStatusSnapshot} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform_type, platform_order_id, store_id, external_store_id, status, last_source_sequence, event_version, ordered_at, provider_occurred_at, delivery_address, customer_request_text, provider_gross_order_amount_snapshot, provider_customer_paid_amount_snapshot, provider_merchant_funded_discount_snapshot, provider_funded_discount_snapshot, provider_financial_data_status_snapshot, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE platform_type = #{platformType} AND platform_order_id = #{platformOrderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, platform_type, platform_order_id, store_id, external_store_id, status, last_source_sequence, event_version, ordered_at, provider_occurred_at, delivery_address, customer_request_text, provider_gross_order_amount_snapshot, provider_customer_paid_amount_snapshot, provider_merchant_funded_discount_snapshot, provider_funded_discount_snapshot, provider_financial_data_status_snapshot, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
